task.title: Correct mismatched plot-data length validation
task.description: Repair the deliberately incorrect same-length comparison in create_plot and satisfy both pytest and the deterministic SonarQube quality gate.
requirements: Make create_plot compare the lengths of x_data and y_data rather than comparing x_data with itself.
Raise a descriptive ValueError when the two data sequences have different lengths.
Add a focused pytest regression test for mismatched data lengths so the new validation branch is covered.
Preserve the existing CSV validation, successful plotting behavior, and public API.
Do not change sonar-project.properties, quality-gate rules, analysis scope, or tests merely to suppress the finding.
acceptance_criteria: SonarQube reports a passing quality gate.
The reliability finding for the duplicated comparison is absent after the repair.
The generated coverage report gives Sonar at least 80 percent coverage on new code.
No Sonar suppression or validation weakening is introduced.

approval.content: Correct create_plot's duplicated length comparison so mismatched x_data and y_data raise a descriptive ValueError. Add a focused regression test that covers the error branch. Preserve the public API and existing behavior. Do not change or suppress SonarQube configuration; allow the deterministic review node to verify the repair.

code.content: The starting fixture deliberately checks len(x_data) against len(x_data), so unequal y_data is never rejected. Change the right-hand expression to len(y_data), retain the descriptive ValueError, and add a mismatched-length regression test.
